who: Clarence L. Mohr, historian of the American South at Tulane and South Alabama; PhD Georgia 1975.

evidence.says: The author biography identifies Clarence L. Mohr as a historian who taught at Tulane for seventeen years before becoming history professor and chair at South Alabama.
The history newsletter identifies Clarence L. Mohr as a former Georgia doctoral student, PhD 1975, and South Alabama history department head.
The authority identifies Clarence L. Mohr through On the Threshold of Freedom and gives Clarence Lee Mohr as another form of the name.
The department profile confirms the Georgia PhD and lists On the Threshold of Freedom and the coauthored history of Tulane.

notes: The degree year and Tulane career identify the LC candidate. Direct confirmation of Turner's advising was not located.
